assignments_current_head.name: assignments_current_head
assignments_current_head.where: "organization_assignments"."kind" = 'HEAD' and "organization_assignments"."ends_at" is null and "organization_assignments"."revoked_at" is null

assignments_current_director.name: assignments_current_director
assignments_current_director.where: "organization_assignments"."kind" = 'DIRECTOR' and "organization_assignments"."ends_at" is null and "organization_assignments"."revoked_at" is null

assignments_department_kind.name: assignments_department_kind
assignments_department_kind.value: ("organization_assignments"."kind" = 'DIRECTOR' and "organization_assignments"."department_id" is null) or ("organization_assignments"."kind" <> 'DIRECTOR' and "organization_assignments"."department_id" is not null)

assignments_substitute_finite.name: assignments_substitute_finite
assignments_substitute_finite.value: "organization_assignments"."kind" <> 'SUBSTITUTE' or ("organization_assignments"."ends_at" is not null and "organization_assignments"."source_assignment_id" is not null)

employees_address_length.name: employees_address_length
employees_address_length.value: "employees"."address" is null or char_length("employees"."address") between 1 and 500

schedule_location.name: schedule_location
schedule_location.value: ("schedule_assignments"."modality" = 'ONSITE' and "schedule_assignments"."location_id" is not null) or ("schedule_assignments"."modality" = 'HOME_OFFICE' and "schedule_assignments"."location_id" is null)

schedule_lifecycle.name: schedule_lifecycle
schedule_lifecycle.value: ("schedule_assignments"."status" = 'DRAFT' and "schedule_assignments"."published_at" is null and "schedule_assignments"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("schedule_assignments"."status" = 'PUBLISHED' and "schedule_assignments"."published_at" is not null and "schedule_assignments"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("schedule_assignments"."status" = 'CANCELLED' and "schedule_assignments"."cancelled_at" is not null and char_length(btrim("schedule_assignments"."cancellation_reason")) > 0)

attendance_absence_bounds.name: attendance_absence_bounds
attendance_absence_bounds.value: "attendance_policies"."administrative_absence_minutes" is null or ("attendance_policies"."administrative_absence_minutes" between 1 and 1440 and "attendance_policies"."administrative_absence_minutes" > "attendance_policies"."late_tolerance_minutes")

attendance_policy_bounds.name: attendance_policy_bounds
attendance_policy_bounds.value: "attendance_policies"."late_tolerance_minutes" between 0 and 120 and "attendance_policies"."early_entry_minutes" between 0 and 1440 and "attendance_policies"."late_exit_minutes" between 0 and 1440
